menu.dropin_coop.title: Co-op Worlds
text.dropin_coop.empty: No co-op worlds yet. Import one of your worlds, or join with an invite.
text.dropin_coop.drop_hint: You can also drop a world folder or .zip here.
text.dropin_coop.list_failed: The co-op world list could not be read. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.first_join_needs_host: Nobody is playing this world right now. Your first join needs a friend to be online, because there is no copy on this PC yet.
text.dropin_coop.status.playing_no_copy: %s is playing (no copy here; world download arrives in the next version)
text.dropin_coop.status.no_copy: Nobody online, and no copy on this PC yet
text.dropin_coop.status.unreachable: Can't check who is online; you can still host
text.dropin_coop.import.title: Import a world as co-op
text.dropin_coop.import.none: No worlds in saves that are not co-op yet.
text.dropin_coop.import.copy_attached: This copy of %s is ready to play.
text.dropin_coop.import.open: %s is open right now. Close it first.
text.dropin_coop.import.needs_invite: %s is a co-op world, but this PC has no key for it. Use Join with invite.
text.dropin_coop.import.too_old: %s is from an older version. Open it once in singleplayer to upgrade it, then import.
text.dropin_coop.import.too_new: %s is from a newer version of the game and cannot be imported.
text.dropin_coop.import.no_level_dat: %s is not a world: there is no level.dat in it.
text.dropin_coop.import.not_a_world: %s is not a world folder or a .zip of one.
text.dropin_coop.import.zip_escape: %s was refused: it contains a file path that leaves the world folder.
text.dropin_coop.import.backup_failed: The backup of %s failed, so nothing was changed.
text.dropin_coop.import.copy_failed: %s could not be copied into saves.
text.dropin_coop.invite.title: Invite to %s
text.dropin_coop.invite.explain: Send this code to your friends. Anyone who has it can join this world.
text.dropin_coop.invite.bad: That is not a valid invite code.
text.dropin_coop.invite.failed: The invite could not be saved. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.join.title: Join with invite
text.dropin_coop.join.label: Paste the invite code
text.dropin_coop.remove.title: Remove %s from co-op?
text.dropin_coop.remove.question: The world stays as an ordinary singleplayer world. The co-op key on this PC is deleted; you need the invite to join again.
text.dropin_coop.remove.done: %s is no longer a co-op world on this PC.
text.dropin_coop.remove.failed: %s could not be removed. See the log.
text.dropin_coop.owner.not_owner: Only the owner of %s has an owner key.
text.dropin_coop.owner.exported: Owner key saved to %s. Keep it private and safe.
text.dropin_coop.owner.export_failed: The owner key of %s could not be exported. See the log.
